_comment: SOURCED per-model physical dimensions. This file is the write path for the
values that have NO published standard behind them, which is why
StandardsIngestor refuses to touch them:
gpu      length, height, slot_width, tdp
cooler   height, radiator_length
case     max_gpu_length, max_cpu_cooler_height
psu      length
ram      heatspreader_height
Guessing these would turn an honest UNVERIFIED into a false PASS, so every
entry must carry its evidence:
pcpp_id   PCPartPicker product ID, CASE-SENSITIVE. This is how a row is
matched. Do not change its case: the IDs are mixed-case and
distinct products differ only by case, so normalising it merges
unrelated hardware. See duplicate-product-census.php.
source    the manufacturer's own spec page the figure came from
retrieved ISO date the figure was read
Only these keys are written, each range-checked for sanity:
length, height, width, depth, slot_width, tdp,
max_gpu_length, max_cpu_cooler_height, radiator_length, heatspreader_height
A figure that disagrees with a value already in the catalogue is reported as
a CONFLICT and NOT written - the catalogue may already be correct.
How to add an entry: read the figure off the vendor's spec page, record the
URL and date, and never infer a value from a product name.
_verified_against: never populated from a product name or a family convention
